mapper.update: INSERT INTO management_index (merge_key, period, net_sales_summary_of_business_results, net_sales_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, operating_revenue1_summary_of_business_results, operating_revenue1_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, operating_revenue2_summary_of_business_results, operating_revenue2_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, gross_operating_revenue_summary_of_business_results, gross_operating_revenue_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, ordinary_income_summary_of_business_results, ordinary_income_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, net_premiums_written_summary_of_business_results_ins, net_premiums_written_summary_of_business_results_ins_unit_ref, ordinary_income_loss_summary_of_business_results, ordinary_income_loss_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, net_income_loss_summary_of_business_results, net_income_loss_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, capital_stock_summary_of_business_results, capital_stock_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, net_assets_summary_of_business_results, net_assets_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, total_assets_summary_of_business_results, total_assets_summary_of_business_results_unit_ref, number_of_employees, number_of_employees_unit_ref) VALUES (#{mergeKey}, #{period}, #{netSalesSummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{netSalesSummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{operatingRevenue1SummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{operatingRevenue1SummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{operatingRevenue2SummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{operatingRevenue2SummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{grossOperatingRevenueSummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{grossOperatingRevenueSummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{ordinaryIncomeSummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{ordinaryIncomeSummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{netPremiumsWrittenSummaryOfBusinessResultIns}, #{netPremiumsWrittenSummaryOfBusinessResultsInsUnitRef}, #{ordinaryIncomeLossSummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{ordinaryIncomeLossSummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{netIncomeLossSummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{netIncomeLossSummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{capitalStockSummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{capitalStockSummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{netAssetsSummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{netAssetsSummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{totalAssetsSummaryOfBusinessResults}, #{totalAssetsSummaryOfBusinessResultsUnitRef}, #{numberOfEmployees}, #{numberOfEmployeesUnitRef}) ON CONFLICT (merge_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO finance_management (company_id, finance_id, management_index_id, inserted_at, updated_at, deleted, sync_id) SELECT c.company_id, f.finance_id, m.management_index_id, now(), now(), false, #{syncId}::uuid FROM company c JOIN finance f ON f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} JOIN management_index m ON m.merge_key = #{mergeKey} WHERE c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} ON CONFLICT (company_id, finance_id, management_index_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = false, updated_at = now(), sync_id = EXCLUDED.sync_id WHERE finance_management.deleted IS DISTINCT FROM false OR finance_management.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.sync_id

UPDATE finance_management fm SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company c JOIN finance f ON f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} WHERE fm.company_id = c.company_id AND fm.finance_id = f.finance_id AND c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND fm.deleted = false

UPDATE finance_management fm SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company c JOIN finance f ON f.merge_key = #{financeMergeKey} WHERE fm.company_id = c.company_id AND fm.finance_id = f.finance_id AND c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND fm.deleted = false AND fm.sync_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{syncId}::uuid

UPDATE finance_management fm SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() FROM company c JOIN company_finance cf ON cf.company_id = c.company_id WHERE fm.company_id = c.company_id AND fm.finance_id = cf.finance_id AND c.corporate_number = #{corporateNumber} AND cf.deleted = true AND fm.deleted = false
